notes.title: The Gauntlet Update Released!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to face the final challenge in Minimancer? The Gauntlet is now open to those who have completed the game and unlocked all the minions.

For those of you who have not yet completed every level, the Gauntlet stepping stones will light up and show you which areas you have yet to complete.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958814/d3d199fab5cb9f6ae3f2a11d94cb16715f04e312.png[/img]

Do you think you have what it takes to beat the Gauntlet? Do you have the wits to take down 7 waves of enemies and the Gauntlet Champion?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958814/9d81e6b7f2bcfff6c4b92c7bf26849a86211b47e.png[/img]

notes.title: Minimancer Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
A lot of the feedback on Minimancer has been focused around the lack of endgame challenges and a sense of the game just fizzling out towards the end. 
So prepare your best teams of minions and get ready to face the Gauntlet! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958814/d3d199fab5cb9f6ae3f2a11d94cb16715f04e312.png[/img]

This is a challenge map that will unlock only once you have completed every other map. The glowing stepping stones will light up to show your progress through the land and once they are all alight, you will have proven yourself worthy enough to challenge the Gauntlet.

Look out for more previews in the coming days!

notes.title: Demo Version Released
notes.notes: The Minimancer Demo has released today! In it, you will have full access to the entire starter area, with all the neutral-element maps and minions available. That's a full 14% of the game to play with, for free!
